title: Kamailio World 2025: Dates And Location
html:
A short announcement to inform that the dates for next Kamailio World Conference have been set to May 12-13, 2025, the event to take place again in Berlin, Germany. It will be a different venue than the past edition.

The event website and more details will be published soon at:

  • https://www.kamailioworld.com

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
